title: Chapter 791
paragraphs: Chapter 791
Episode 195. To the old Otterium (2)
"Are you saying you're going to start digging now?"
"Yep."
Valeria found it strange that they were suddenly going to start digging without any preparation, but then she remembered that there were two superhumans here.
Jin and Hedo were the ones who could dig the deepest and largest hole in the world if they wanted.
"Well, the construction of the foundation of the underground construction site in Geomhwangji was done in the same way."
The old Otterium had been an unprotected area, a completely abandoned land, even before Geomhwangseongjeon. Meaning, it didn't matter if they tore up and destroyed this vast land.
Jin and Hedo stretched and took off their coats.
"Miss Valeria, it's better if you stay back. Hmm... Over there seems suitable. Just wait a moment."

Suddenly, Hedo rushed to a spot about a mile away and secured a place. Then, he broke a few rocks about the size of a human body and made them into flat plates and poles. The rocks shattered like dry twigs under his monstrous strength.

What he made from the broken rocks was a sort of makeshift table and a sunshade. It looked quite decent when he tore up a coat and a shirt and laid them straight on top. On the table were some snacks packed by Latry and even teacups he had somehow prepared.
"Relax and have some tea over there. If you're enjoying tea, the young lady will come... I believe she won't hit you, even if she behaves rudely."

Upon hearing Hedo's words, Valeria blinked her eyes and alternately looked at him and the table. It was astonishing that he was able to create such a decent resting place in this desolate and dark land.
"...You seem very accustomed to this. Has this kind of thing happened often?"
"As you know, our young lady is quite a handful. From my perspective, she doesn't dislike you as much as it seems. It would be great if you could be a little more understanding."
Feeling like she was observing the feelings of a father who had a seriously wayward daughter, Valeria momentarily grew solemn. Jin also sighed deeply.
"As long as Sandra doesn't physically attack me first, I guess... I can have tea with her."
"Oh, if there's a mature adult in this era, it's you, Miss Valeria."
"Enough, it's pressuring."
[Meow!]
Jin took Shuri out of the Red Jade Casket. He intended to stop any unpleasant situations that might occur while Valeria and Sandra were waiting.
"Shuri, take Valeria over there and play together. If the atmosphere gets tense, try to calm things down."
[Meow-meow.]
As Shuri and Valeria moved towards the table, Hedo lit a cigarette.

"I hope one day Miss Sandra and Miss Valeria can become friends. Miss Valeria seems to have changed a lot since her visit to Honka Island. If the young lady changes a bit, it won't be a completely fanciful story."
Sandra, who was roaming around nearby, squinted her eyes as soon as she saw Valeria sitting at the table, and Hedo shook his head with a sigh.
"You have a hard time."
"It's also a blessing. Well, let's start digging the ground now."
Vroom!

Hedo drew his new beloved sword 'Georyeok'. Georyeok was a super-large sword very similar to Shakan, which he used until he handed it over to Veil, and was Picon's new masterpiece. Of course, Hedo was incredibly satisfied with Georyeok.
"I didn't know that the first thing to cut with this perfect and beautiful sword would be the ground."
"Don't be too discouraged, something significant might come out. Like a portal to the demon world."
"That would be enough for Georyeok's debut."
Huh!
Hedo took a deep breath and got into position. Just that alone caused the nearby chunks of ground to vibrate heavily, and rocks to bounce around.
Kwang-!
A sound like a giant smashing down a column of a castle rather than a sword. Jin, who had jumped up to avoid the shockwave, saw the land collapsing in a foolish manner.
An approximately fifty-step wide semicircular hole had been carved. The depth far exceeded Hedo's height.
'If it wasn't for Yona Nunim in the Sota desert, everyone would probably be dead by Hedo's hand.'
Before Jin could even land, Hedo struck the hole again with tremendous strength. Massive rocks flew into the sky like popping corn.

After a few more thunderous noises, Jin also thrust Sidmund into the broken ground. With every explosion of lightning from the sword, the hole deepened by two steps. The inside of the hole became firmer as they went further, and debris occasionally poured down like a landslide.
Of course, the two didn't get buried in debris. The debris disintegrated into particles by the continuous sword energy and shockwaves.

At some point, Jin and Hedo swung their swords in sync like skilled workers; you swing once, I swing once. The site of the Dark Magic Conference was long swallowed up below the pit, and the ground continued to scream in agony.
Glug.
Valeria watched the bizarre scene of the two men beating the ground as she drank the tea she had cooled with magic.
There was no particular place to look, and it was also to ignore Sandra, who was sitting in front of her with a gruff look.
"Hey, Shuri!"
[Meow?]
Before she could curse at Valeria, Sandra called Shuri first.
"Why are you offering your tail to this redhead. Turn it this way. I want to lean on it comfortably, too."
[Meow meow meow.]
"Ah, quickly!"
[Meow, meow.]
Shuri, who was glancing around, subtly moved her tail towards Sandra when Valeria didn't react. Of course, Sandra's antics didn't end there.
"Redhead, stop looking at our Jin."
"Jin disappeared into the hole a long time ago."
"I mean, look somewhere else where Jin is not, right?"
"Oh, I was looking at the void beyond the pit."
"Ugh. Ugh, ugh."
Sandra was momentarily speechless. And, surprisingly, at that moment, Valeria felt Sandra seemed like a child for the first time.

She felt like she was dealing with a little kid who had gone astray due to unfortunate abuse, not Sandra 'Zifl'. Yes, what could a child do wrong? It was the monsters who made her that way that were the problem. That's how she felt.
So Valeria pointed to the cookies in front of her.
"These are saved for you. Stop glaring and eat these."
"Ha! My share? From the start, everything Hedo picked was mine, you know? Your cookies never existed, you're a thief who acted without my permission. Understand?"

"How can all these be your cookies? Ratry nim had it packed for everyone to share. Strictly speaking, since you and I are eating without leaving any for Jin and Hedo, if this is stealing, then you are also an accomplice."
Sandra was speechless again.
She couldn't hit that damned redhead with any damage just by throwing random curses because she couldn't answer.
"Who... is going to eat all of it? I'll properly leave Jin's share."
"Then I'll leave Hedo's share."
"What are you to take care of Hedo?"
"Then you take care of both."
"Then there's nothing left for me to eat!"
Snicker.
When Valeria broke out in laughter, Sandra, unable to stand it, jumped up to swing her fist, but Shuri held her back with her tail.
"Let me go! You're really on her side!"
Thanks to that, Valeria had one more place to look at. The view of Jin and Hedo digging a hole foolishly and Sandra swinging back and forth tied by a tail. Neither was a common scene.
'It's not that annoying thinking of her as a child.'
Suddenly, crack!
About the time Valeria was having such thoughts, the ground near the table suddenly cracked.
Despite the distance of three miles between the pit and the table, the whole area started to collapse due to Jin and Hedo's digging.
There was a need to find a place further away from the pit.
[Meow meow!]
Shuri bit the teapot and table in her mouth. Valeria naturally climbed onto Shuri's back while holding her teacup, and Sandra was still tied up by the tail.
"We need to move now, know your place, redhead!"
"I told you just now, eat this."

A cookie that Valeria flung went into Sandra's mouth. For some reason, Sandra swallowed the cookie with a bitter feeling and cursed, while Shuri picked up speed heading out of the influence of the digging.
"Sure enough, just now when I went up and saw, problems started to appear up to the ground under the table. Shuri is moving the ladies. The lady for some reason was tied up to the tail like luggage."
"Fortunately, it seems the atmosphere over there was not too bad."
"We should be thankful to Miss Valeria. Phew, I don't know how much we have dug. I think it should be about five hundred steps."
"I think that's about right for me too."
"If we keep using our strength like this, you and I might dig the deepest hole in human history."
"Shinu said that even if the underworld exists on the same star, it's an area that can't be reached by normal means, so we have to do that much."

Naturally, the depth of the pit dug by the two had already far exceeded the limit of modern technology. It was possible because these two outstanding superhumans among the non-standard ones were carrying out the excavation themselves.
"By the way, I don't know why there are so many monsters underground."

Due to this tremendous excavation, hundreds of monsters have already lost their lives. Most of the monsters hiding underground vanished along with the soil and rocks without even being able to scream.
"They would have been troublesome if they had come to the surface someday. Let's keep digging. Somehow, I don't feel bad."
Jin and Hedo were feeling their own pleasure in exerting their strength as much as possible. The excavation continued like cheerful laborers. It went on for half a day.
The two men, who were covered in dirt and black dust, stopped digging after more than two hours after half a day had passed.
Crack!

For the first time from the ground that had been bursting like tofu all the time, a sword was flung out. Something sturdy enough to withstand even the swords that the two had struck with all their might was causing a reaction.
"Oh!"
The two simultaneously exclaimed and looked down. When they swept away the soil and rock that covered the sword mark with their palms, a shiny and massive mineral-like object was revealed.
But to be precise, it was not an object, but a living creature.
"...Scales? Jin, this. It looks like dragon scales."
"Yes, Hedo sir. It looks like that to me too."
Why are there dragon scales here out of nowhere?
The moment the two thought so.
[Who dares... disturb my sleep.]
A gloomy and dark voice was spreading throughout the pit.
